# eval-harness-mini

> Minimal evaluation harness: golden JSONL datasets, built-in scorers, CI pass thresholds, a stable JSON report and an opt-in pytest plugin Python package `trysac-eval-harness-mini`, import name `eval_harness_mini`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
